map.Morse 主要适用于成人住院患者，儿童与 ICU 建议改用 Schmid 或: Morse is mainly intended for adult inpatients; for children and ICU patients, dedicated scales such as Schmid or Humphreys are recommended instead.
map.Morse 跌倒风险评分在线评估工具，基于 6 项量表（总分 125）判定低风险: Online Morse fall risk assessment tool based on a 6-item scale (125 total points) that grades from low risk to very high risk, used for fall-prevention care of inpatients; pure front end.
map.→ 打开跌倒风险（Morse评分）评估工具: -> Open the fall risk (Morse score) evaluation tool
map.不能，仅作维度核对与培训演示，正式评分以护士床旁评估单与签字为准。: No. This is only for dimension checking and training demonstration; the official score is the bedside assessment sheet signed by a nurse.
map.儿童或 ICU 患者适用吗？: Does it apply to children or ICU patients?

map.按就高不就低原则纳入高危管理，并以实际步态与认知观察为准。: Treat the higher rating as governing for high-risk management, and defer to actual observations of gait and cognition.
map.新入院或转科患者 24 小时内完成 Morse 评分，≥45 分列为高危并挂防跌: Newly admitted or transferred patients complete the Morse score within 24 hours; a score of 45 or above is classed as high risk and a fall-prevention sign is attached.
map.日常生活能力 Barthel 指数分级器: Activities of daily living Barthel index grader
map.服用镇静催眠或降压药后复评，步态与认知维度变化时及时上调风险。: Re-assess after taking sedative-hypnotic or antihypertensive drugs, and raise the risk rating promptly when the gait or cognition dimensions change.
map.本工具能替代医院 Morse 评估单吗？: Can this tool replace the hospital Morse assessment sheet?
map.术后下床活动前复评，静脉输液或镇痛泵未拔除者自动计入静脉治疗项。: Re-assess before the patient gets out of bed after surgery; those with an IV line or analgesic pump still in place are automatically counted under the IV therapy item.
map.评分接近临界值（如 44/45）如何处理？: How is a score close to the cut-off (such as 44/45) handled?
map.：患者既往跌倒 1 次、使用助行器、留置针输液、步态需搀扶，六项累加得 55 分: : the patient has one prior fall, uses a walking aid, has an IV cannula in place and needs support when walking; the six items sum to 55 points, which is graded high risk, consistent with the ward assessment sheet.
